reviewed_clauses.research_interpretation: Route A requires at least two final unconditional approvals in the preceding three years, including FDA or central EMA as reference; excludes reliance/recognition-derived approvals. Domestic review and additional requirements remain.
reviewed_clauses.version_alignment: Cover explicitly dated March 2025 and labelled pilot programme; separate April 2025 submission clarifications retained as a supplement. Not a 2024 statute.
